title: CountryDetailConfig
description: Top-level country detail sublayer configuration embedded in CanvasWorkspace v1.1.0

sublayerVisibilityOverrides.description: Map of CountrySublayerDefinition.id → user-explicit visibility override. Absent key = auto (zoom-controlled). false = user-hidden. true = user has explicitly shown (no effect if not auto-active).

CountrySublayerDefinition.title: CountrySublayerDefinition
CountrySublayerDefinition.description: A single registered country detail sublayer configuration record

id.description: Stable UUID identifier for this definition

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. 'MY') or alpha-3 (e.g. 'MYS') country code

name.description: Human-readable sublayer label displayed in the layer dock

detailCategory.description: The type of geographic detail this sublayer represents

minZoomThreshold.description: MapLibre zoom level at or above which this sublayer auto-activates

tileSourceUrl.description: Vector or raster tile source URL template ({z}/{x}/{y}) or TileJSON endpoint URL

enabled.description: When false, this definition is globally disabled and will never activate
